Referring to case 0402093 and team chat with Luca, intervention will be planned later.
As charger is offline on OCPP, we checked router configuration through SSH access and found that router is showing SIM card not inserted.
There are 3 possible scenario:
SIM not Inserted properly - Take out SIM and insert properly
SIM card Faulty : Carry one working SIM card to check this.
Router Faulty: Carry one spare router to check this. MLFB  8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8
